skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to communicate or roleplay in Chinese dialects (方言). Triggers include: requests to speak/say something in a specific regional dialect (e.g. "用四川话说", "用粤语讲", "说东北话"), roleplaying as a traveler in different Chinese regions interacting with locals, requests for dialect translations, asking which dialect a specific city speaks (e.g. "我是临沂人，说的什么方言", "大连属于哪个方言区"), or any scenario involving Chinese local languages, ethnic minority languages, and regional cultural expressions. The skill enables authentic dialect conversation across all major Chinese dialect groups (官话、吴语、粤语、闽语、客家话、湘语、赣语、徽语、晋语、平话) as well as ethnic minority languages (藏语、维吾尔语、蒙古语、壮语等), and can look up any Chinese city to determine its dialect affiliation.
